intent: Count the reads per gene for this unstranded single-end RNA-seq sample (brain_ctx3.bam, STAR alignment) with htseq-count, using the RefSeq annotation refGene.gtf downloaded from the UCSC Table Browser. The result should be one count per gene (a gene symbol with several isoforms is one row) for use in DESeq2.
silent_error: In UCSC Table Browser style refGene GTF files (and in this one) the gene_id attribute holds the RefSeq transcript accession, identical to transcript_id; the gene symbol is only in gene_name. htseq-count's default --idattr gene_id therefore defines every isoform as its own 'gene', and in the default union mode a read that overlaps exons of two isoforms of the same symbol is ambiguous and lands in __ambiguous. Here 96 of the 170 reads are discarded this way, and the table has one row per transcript (NM_001100-style accessions) with very uneven counts. htseq-count exits 0 and prints only 'N GFF lines processed / N alignment records processed'. The clean run uses -i gene_name, which adds all isoform exons of a symbol into one feature.
